Exact revision uses typed revision-to-subject coherence and nonempty version/digest Tokens. Actual referent resolution,hash algorithm/digest input,version identity,currentness and immutable binding are unaccepted.
Nonempty provenance with typed members is a candidate reading of with provenance;actual source/evidence/chain authenticity and minimal required provenance contents remain unresolved.

Confidence,lifecycle,branch and contestability are typed generic facets. Evidence/commitment confidence decomposition,schemes/calibration,enums,join epochs and effective challenges remain separate carrier/runtime contracts.

Node cannot be its own represented subject,revision,subject identity carrier or Definition,or a GlobalTruthProof. Actual claim truth may exist independently;the term alone does not entail it or authority.
